Title: NETMESSAGE:FROM: #### \nTO: #### \nSUBJECT: OPERATION CROSSED PATHS
Translation: 发件人：#### \n收件人：#### \n主题：交错路径行动

Title:
NETMESSAGE:THE PMC COMPLETED THE MISSION WITH UNEXPECTED EFFICIENCY. IN FACT, \n
THEY HAVE CAPABILITIES EVEN US CAN ONLY SALIVATE OVER. \n
I AM SURE THAT THIS LATEST DEVELOPMENT IS THE PROOF WE NEEDED TO DEEPEN \n
OUR PARTNERSHIP.
Translation:
PMC以出乎意料的效率完成了任务。事实上， 

他们拥有的能力连我们也只能垂涎。 

我相信这一最新进展就是我们所需的证据，以深化 

我们的合作伙伴关系。

Title:
NETMESSAGE:THIS IS A FACADE OF FAILURE.\n
NOW THAT THE CRYSTAL IS DESTROYED, THE BALANCE OF POWER IS RESTORED FOR\n
THE TIME BEING.\n
AS OF NOW THE PMC SQUAD IS STILL OFFICIALLY MIA.
Translation:
这是失败的假象。

现在水晶已被摧毁，力量平衡暂时恢复了。

截至目前，PMC小队仍被官方列为失踪。
